The '''Melahna system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of [[Melahnese food|Melahnese cuisine]].<ref name="CSWE Melahnese">{{CSWECite|II|303|Melahnese cuisine}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Melahnese food|Melahnese cuisine]]|system=Melahna [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Melahna [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-9.<ref name="TEA" />
